reviews.title: Solid and the drawer runs smoothly
reviews.body: Ordered two for either side of the bed. They feel solid, the walnut finish matches our bed well and the drawer slides without catching.

reviews.title: Fits our narrow hallway
reviews.body: Took about ten minutes to put together. Holds all our everyday shoes and it is light enough to move when we clean.

reviews.title: Comfortable for a full workday
reviews.body: The mesh back stays cool even in the afternoon. I would have liked a little more lumbar support, but for the price it is a good chair.

reviews.title: Plenty of room for two screens
reviews.body: We went with the larger size and it takes two monitors and a printer comfortably. Sturdy, no wobble.

reviews.title: Chairs are fine, delivery was not
reviews.body: The chairs themselves are what we expected. Most of this review is about the courier, who kept calling at odd hours.

reviews.title: Our living room finally feels finished
reviews.body: The cushions are firm in a good way and the wood has a nice even polish. Delivery took nine days and the team set it up for us.

reviews.title: Good build, cushions need a week
reviews.body: Frame is strong and the beige fabric looks better in person. The seat cushions felt stiff at first and softened after a week or so.

reviews.title: Worth the wait
reviews.body: We compared a few shops in Guwahati before ordering. The finish is clean and nothing creaks.

reviews.title: Happy so far
reviews.body: Delivered last week. Looks good and sits well, I will update after a few months of use.

reviews.title: Good chair for home office
reviews.body: Easy to assemble and the height adjustment works well. The armrests are a bit hard for long calls.

reviews.title: Back pain is better
reviews.body: I sit eight or nine hours a day and this has been much easier on my lower back than my old chair.

reviews.title: Sturdy for everyday use
reviews.body: We use these on the verandah. They stack neatly and have held up well in the rain.

reviews.title: Comfortable armrests
reviews.body: Wider than our old plastic chairs, and the ribbed back is comfortable. The beige shows dust a little.

reviews.title: Customers keep asking about them
reviews.body: We bought twelve for our café. They are light to move, easy to wipe and look warmer than metal chairs.

reviews.title: Nice finish, check the seat height
reviews.body: Lovely walnut colour. The seat is a little low for our counter-height tables, so measure first.

reviews.title: Firm and supportive
reviews.body: We picked the queen size. It is on the firmer side, which suits us, and there was no strong smell after unpacking.

reviews.title: Sleeping much better
reviews.body: Replaced a ten-year-old mattress with this one. My shoulder aches have eased within two weeks.

reviews.title: Review for a different item
reviews.body: This is actually about the pillows I bought elsewhere. They went flat in a month.

reviews.title: Heavy, solid bed
reviews.body: The bed is very solid and the headboard looks just like the photos. Assembly needed two people.

reviews.title: Comfortable for long evenings
reviews.body: The cushion makes a real difference compared with a plain plastic chair. The cover comes off for washing.

reviews.title: Bought four for the balcony
reviews.body: Good quality and the coffee brown colour looks rich. Delivery was on time.

reviews.title: Good set for our hotel lobby
reviews.body: We took the large set. Guests use it all day and it still looks new after two months.

reviews.title: Right size for a study corner
reviews.body: My daughter uses it for school work. Compact, sturdy, and the edges are nicely rounded.

reviews.title: Dinner for six, no squeeze
reviews.body: The table seats six without elbows clashing. One chair had a loose screw that was easy to tighten.

reviews.title: Looks good, a bit small
reviews.body: Stylish and easy to clean. The seat is narrower than I expected, so it suits a small café table better.

reviews.title: Keeps the dust off
reviews.body: The cover keeps shoes out of sight and dust free. The door hinge is plastic but feels fine so far.
